name: Saffron
description: Golden threads of biryani, kheer, and Persian tea.

tcm.note: TCM's fan hong hua moves blood; nature listed neutral-ish.

ayurveda.note: Mildly ushna yet tridoshic — given in milk.

unani.note: Zafran is classically garam and mood-lifting.

nutrition.highlight: crocin is the colour, and the reason for the price

effects.note: Unani tradition already names zafran mood-lifting, and clinical trials — including a 2025 study of over 200 people — back a measurable effect on low mood, cited in depression-treatment guidelines alongside standard care. Those trials use a standardized extract at roughly 28-30mg a day; ordinary cooking uses far less — a pinch is more like 15-30mg of thread for a whole dish, not a single serving — so a spice-jar amount sits well under what was actually tested. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
